tests.scope: Full suite after migration, render-allocation optimization, reproducible legacy fixtures and benchmark validation changes.

browser.mode: hidden background tab; real fullscreen and pointer capture disabled; simulated pointer lock for round completion
browser.training: Sunset loaded and completed a one-second QA round, result persisted
browser.replay: Saved replay loaded its map and played to 1.00 / 1.00 seconds
browser.backup: Full backup exported result/settings, one replay index+blob and editor draft+saved scene
browser.editor: Bind map and custom scene name survived language change and reload
browser.locale: English hall and Studio controls checked; offline-only controls hidden using stable selectors

findings: Ascent median render-submission CPU decreased 32.28% and draw calls decreased 49.32% across three rounds.
Plummet draw calls decreased 15.22%; render-submission CPU did not consistently decrease.
Median 1% low did not improve on either map; these fixed-scene results do not establish a general or high-refresh gameplay FPS gain.
engineMigration.measurementBoundary: CPU submission and render/RAF callback intervals; no completed-GPU-frame rate or display presentation rate was measured.

renderAllocationOptimization.behavior: Differential tests compare native and adjacent-snapshot renderers across repeated renders, tick changes, actor lifecycle changes and rebuilding; snapshot creation and startup/tick invalidation remain unchanged.
renderAllocationOptimization.measurementBoundary: Allocation counts cover the two changed allocation sites. The 12-run background benchmark measures CPU submission and callback cadence, not GPU execution or display presentation; GPU timer disabled.
renderAllocationOptimization.changedModule: js/Do4sYkfr.js (only changed JavaScript module between the isolated builds)
findings: Ascent median render-submission CPU changed +0.57%; Plummet changed -2.50%. Paired CPU changes are +4.76% and -4.62% respectively.
Median submission FPS stayed about 60; 1% low changed -7.53% and -0.18%. No overall FPS improvement is established.
Every run retained maxInFlight=2, unset experimental GPU-budget storage, identical native context settings and no fullscreen/pointer lock.

gpuPollPilot.decision: Zero-timeout clientWaitSync substitution showed no consistent benefit in exploratory one-pair-per-map runs; native getSyncParameter polling retained.

limitations: One-second replay contains no shots or keyframe drift sample; it does not establish deterministic combat replay.
Both completed benchmarks cover two fixed scenes; no exhaustive interactive playthrough of all 100 scenes was performed.
Drawing-submission cadence is not completed GPU or display FPS. The migration benchmark did not establish a general FPS improvement.
All raw scene files were restored and verified byte-for-byte; the short round existed only in isolated staging.
See verification.json for nonliteral import boundaries and 26 source-side legacy-kernel fingerprint differences.
